changes.title: AWS launches support for amortization of EC2 Capacity Blocks for ML
changes.detail: AWS Data Exports for Cost and Usage Report (CUR) 2.0 and AWS Cost Explorer now amortize the upfront fee for Amazon EC2 Capacity Blocks for ML across the duration of each reservation. You can see the amortized cost of each instance launched into a Capacity Block and the amortized cost of unused capacity, so you can attribute your upfront fee to the workloads that used it and identify capacity that went unused. changes.title: AWS Glue Data Catalog now supports catalog-vended credentials with Apache Iceberg REST catalog federation
changes.detail: AWS Glue Data Catalog now supports external catalog's vended credentials in Apache Iceberg REST catalog federation. You can now read external Iceberg tables from Amazon Athena, Amazon EMR, Amazon Redshift, and AWS Glue using coarse-grained table grants in your external Iceberg catalog. Glue Data Catalog already federates to external Iceberg REST catalogs through an AWS IAM role that you configure with access to your Amazon S3 buckets.
